messages.author: cb1b45cdfa4cb9c7
messages.subject: multiple downloadHandlers not working
parts:
Hi all

I'm trying out the downloadHandler functionality.  Works well with 1 but when i have 2 of them (  downloadButton("foo1","Download FOO1"),  downloadButton("foo2","Download  FOO2")   ) , clicking on the buttons loads the app in another window rather downloading the file.

I tried using outputOptions as shown below but to no avail.

outputOptions((output, 'foo1', suspendWhenHidden=FALSE)
outputOptions((output, 'foo2', suspendWhenHidden=FALSE)

Any suggestions?

Thanks,
Philippe

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: multiple downloadHandlers not working
parts:
The problem here is that there are two inputs with the name, so the initialization Javascript for the page isn't getting executed. If you open up the Javascript console on your browser, you'll see an error like this:
"Uncaught Duplicate binding for ID downloadData"

If you rename one of the buttons, it should work.

-Winston
